"'''Father'''" was an elderly, obese [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked as a [[Curator/Legends|curator]] for the [[Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic]]. He made use of a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|hoverchair]] to move around and worked alongside the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos]]. He spoke a language that to [[Marn Hierogryph]] sounded like "whispered squawks," which were readily translated by Obohn.
